prompt: What must happen for P8-R to receive tonight’s corrected time rows?
promptZh: P8-R 要收到今晚修正後的時段資料列，必須完成什麼？
evidence: the systems team must register it before the overnight job can write there. / The systems desk closes at 5:00 p.m.; destination changes received after closing are handled tomorrow.

options.text: Give it the same name as P8-M.
options.zh: 將它改成與 P8-M 同名。
options.why: The guide requires registration, not matching names.
options.whyZh: 指南要求登記目的地，不是讓兩份行事曆同名。

options.text: Leave a copy of the old rows in it.
options.zh: 在裡面保留一份舊時段資料。
options.why: The handover explicitly forbids copying old rows.
options.whyZh: 交班訊息明確禁止複製舊資料列。

options.text: Wait until after 5:00 p.m. to request the change.
options.zh: 等下午五點過後再申請變更。
options.why: After closing, the request will not be handled until tomorrow.
options.whyZh: 服務台關閉後收到的申請，要等明天才會處理。

options.text: Have the systems team register it as the destination before the overnight job.
options.zh: 請系統小組在夜間作業前將它登記為匯出目的地。
options.why: Only the registered destination receives the export; the request must be made before closing to be handled today.
options.whyZh: 只有已登記的目的地會收到匯出；要在今天處理，必須在服務台關閉前提出。

explanationZh: 只有已登記的目的地會收到匯出；要在今天處理，必須在服務台關閉前提出。
